blind.description: A decorative metal finial or chess-like piece featuring a flanged circular base with radial fluting, a segmented central stem encircled by two bronze/brass rings around a central bulb, and a pointed four-lobed spearhead or fleur-de-lis finial cap at the peak. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled with a brushed metallic steel and brass finish. It sits flat on its integrated circular base on the ground.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular base with eight subtle radial ribs, centered with a four-pointed star or cross-shaped tip.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third to one-quarter the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 to 2 ft tall), with a base width of roughly 8 to 10 inches.

notes: slightly thicker/stockier aspect ratio than catalog proportion
